expressions.cn: 你可以帮我吗？ (Nǐ kěyǐ bāng wǒ ma?)
好的 / 明白 (Hǎo de / Míngbái)
对不起，请再说一遍？ / 什么？ (Duìbuqǐ, qǐng zài shuō yī biàn? / Shénme?)
不客气 / 没关系 (Bù kèqì / Méiguānxì)

vocabulary_focus.concept: Asking for permission/excuse me (to get attention/pass)

expressions.cn: 不好意思 / 借过 (Bù hǎoyìsi / Jièguò)
我需要 / 我必须 (Wǒ xūyào / Wǒ bìxū)

work.scenario: You're working on a new task and need assistance from a colleague. Later, your manager gives complex instructions.

life.scenario: Navigating a crowded market, you accidentally bump into someone, then ask for directions. After getting help, you thank the person.
key_phrases: Apa dia? (when you didn't hear the direction clearly)

tech.scenario: Your computer freezes, and you call tech support. You need to explain the issue and understand their technical advice.
